title: Paamal Hasan Ka Laal Hua
body:
qaabu Me Nahi Dil Sarwar Ka
paamal Hasan Ka Laal Hua
01. Qaimo Me Udasi Chaai Hai
dulhan Pe Qayamat Aai Hai
kuch Der Me Ghar Barbaad Hua
<<DIVIDER>>
02. Ghairat Se Jhukaye Sar Dulhan
roti Hai Ke Lut Ta Hai Gulshan
kis Tarah Kare Khismat Ka Gila
<<DIVIDER>>
03. Chaya Hua Qaasim Ka Gham Hai
shaadi Ki Jagah Par Maatam Hai
sayedaaniyo Me Hai Hashr Bapa
<<DIVIDER>>
04. Maidaan Me Ajab Aafat Aai
tasweer E Ali Khoon Me Doobi phir Tukde Hua Dil Shabbar Ka
<<DIVIDER>>
05. Laashe Pa Ye Rokar Ye Shah Ne Kaha
mai Teri Madad Ko Aa Na Saka
ta Hashr Ye Gham Rulwayega
<<DIVIDER>>
06. Sajde Me Jhukaye Maa Ne Sar
qurban Hua Hai Mera Pisar
maqbool Huwi Farwa Ki Dua
<<DIVIDER>>
07. Bas Rok Qalam Ko Aye Manzar
sar Peet Ke Rote Hai Sarwar
kehte The Yehi Pamal Hua
pamal Hua Pamal Hua
